name: The Show presenta Vita Nova
overview: Blindfolded, loaded onto a plane, and abandoned in a foreign country, Jaser doesn't know what country he's in, has no money, and doesn't speak the language. He has only a phone without a SIM card and two goals: to find his whereabouts and build a life from scratch. While Alessandro films him with a hidden camera, he must make friends, find a job, and a place to live.
